question: Can the contained static production surface become a polished read-only AiFi evidence console and be safely promoted to canary.0x402.sh with the exact validated commit and no payment or action path?
startingState: The Base/effect/journal/shadow evidence system is complete at commit 3ead868 and the branch is clean, but the public site is an older static containment page with no evidence-status API or production UI for the new system; deployment state must be revalidated.
boundedChange: Build a responsive static operator evidence console, a sanitized same-origin read-only evidence-status API shared with the local dashboard, strict security headers and containment tests; verify locally and in a Vercel preview; publish the validated artifact through the existing Git/Vercel production workflow and verify canary.0x402.sh live. No private journal/artifact exposure, Base RPC from the browser, arbitrary URL input, payment, wallet, signing, transaction submission, retry/action execution, Bankr mutation, or unrelated infrastructure changes.
successCondition: The UI visibly presents the four evidence layers, conformance outcomes, explicit assurance limits, and live containment status; browser console/network and responsive checks pass; health/evidence APIs return the expected sanitized schemas; legacy routes stay HTTP 410 with zero outbound requests; preview and production are READY at the exact reviewed commit; canary.0x402.sh serves the new UI and security headers.
failureCondition: The UI or API exposes secrets/private evidence, claims external truth not proven, introduces an action/payment/wallet/signing/transaction/retry path, accepts caller-selected URLs, contacts Base or third parties from the browser/public handlers, weakens legacy containment, deploys an unreviewed commit, or production verification does not match the validated preview.
requiredReceipts: Local full-suite, build, static containment, and browser responsive/console/network verification
Vercel preview URL and exact-commit verification receipt
Production deployment/domain receipt with live UI/API/legacy-route/security-header checks and error-log scan
